title: Isolation and expansion of the hepatic progenitor cell \(HPC) population
protocol: Sacrifice mouse.
In vivo perfuse with 5-10 ml of PBS from the IVC, followed by 5-10 ml of Liver Digest Medium (Gibco).
Harvest liver without including gall bladder and transfer to a tube containing Williams’E medium + 10% FCS.
Cut liver into fine pieces and incubate in Liver Digest Medium at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Mesh liver more either with mechanical chopping using scalpel or Miltenyi GentleMACS.
Pass meshed liver through a 100 μm cell strainer, then top up with 25 ml of Williams’E medium + 10% FCS.
Spin tubes at 50 G for 5 minutes with acceleration =4 and deceleration=4.
Transfer supernatant to new 50 ml falcon while passing through a 40 μm strainer, discard the pellet.
Repeat step spinning at 50 G for 5 minutes with acceleration =4 and deceleration=4.
Spin tubes at 300 G for 5 minutes with maximum acceleration and deceleration.
Keep pellet, discard supernatant.
Incubate pellet with red cell lysis buffer on ice for 2 minutes.
Wash pellet with 10 ml of PBS at 300 G.
Repeat step spinning at 300 G for 5 minutes with maximum acceleration and deceleration.
The resulting pellet will be the non-parenchymal fraction of the liver. Can either plate or continue with FACS.
Block cells with either Fc Block or neat FCS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Spin the samples at 300G for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Incubate the samples with antibody mix on ice for 30 minutes to 1 hour, using approximately 50-100 μl per sample.
Wash the samples with FACS buffer (PBS + 2% FCS).
Spin the samples at 300G for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the samples in 300 μl of FACS buffer and transfer them to a FACS tube equipped with a 40 μm cell strainer cap.
Sort the samples for CD45-/CD31-/Ter119-/EpCAM+/CD24+/CD133+ cells.
Add a life/dead marker to exclude dead cells, using DAPI/7AAD before sorting.
Coat plates with 1 mg/ml Rat Tail Collagen 1 (Sigma).
Leave the coated plates in the incubator for approximately 4 hours to dry.
Plate cells with liver expansion medium.
Wait for colony formation.
After colony formation, change the medium every 2-3 days.
Prepare medium relatively fresh in 5 ml aliquots or smaller.
Passage primary mouse HPCs.
Incubate with diluted trypsin until cells start to detach.
Flush colony with Williams’E + 10%FCS.
Collect cells and spin at 300G for 5 minutes.
Replate cells on collagen-coated plates.
